findings.evidence: Side-by-side of the two files: identical `let pulled`/`let sourcePulled`/`hcancel` blocks, identical `rw [..., Iso.trans_hom, eqToIso.hom, ← Category.assoc, ..., mkQuotient_comp_eqToHom, mkQuotient_comp_quotientIsoOfIso_hom]` scripts, identical `hom_ext` script; only the identifier prefix differs.
findings.fix: Factor the shared part once, e.g. in TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/Radical/Basic.lean: a lemma `comapOfSurjective_eq_of_isLeast {C : ∀ H, HopfIdeal k H → Prop} (hcomap : ∀ {H K} (e : H ≅ K) {I}, C K I → C H (I.comapOfSurjective (toBialgHom e.hom) _)) (hIH : C H IH) (hIK : C K IK) (hleH : ∀ J, C H J → IH ≤ J) (hleK : ∀ J, C K J → IK ≤ J) (e : H ≅ K) : IK.comapOfSurjective (toBialgHom e.hom) _ = IH`, plus the induced iso and its refl/trans/symm laws stated for a least-candidate ideal. Instantiate for both radicals and delete the unipotent copies (no compatibility layer needed). The project already uses exactly this idiom: `HopfIdeal.exists_maximal_finrank_quotientLie` (TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/HopfIdeal/Cotangent.lean:402) is generic over the candidate predicate and serves both radicals, and `geometricNormalSubgroupFreeCommHopfAlgProperty` (Radical/Basic.lean:56) factors the reductive/semisimple pair.
findings.issue: The whole file duplicates TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/Unipotent/Radical/Isomorphism.lean modulo `unipotent`→`solvable`: `comapOfSurjective_solvableRadicalDefiningIdeal` (94) vs `comapOfSurjective_unipotentRadicalDefiningIdeal` (88), `solvableRadicalIsoOfIso` (122) vs `unipotentRadicalIsoOfIso` (116), the two comp lemmas (130, 140) vs (124, 135), `solvableRadical_hom_ext` (149) vs `unipotentRadical_hom_ext` (144), and `_refl`/`_trans`/`_symm` (163, 172, 189) vs (158, 167, 184) — same proof scripts token for token, even the module docstring. Nothing in these proofs uses unipotence or solvability; they use only (i) the candidate predicate is stable under comap along an iso and (ii) the defining ideal is the least candidate.

summary: TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/Solvable/Radical/Isomorphism.lean is a near-verbatim rename-clone of TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/Unipotent/Radical/Isomorphism.lean (docstring included); every declaration after `comapOfIso` is generic in the candidate predicate and should be proved once. Several proof steps also re-derive located lemmas in HopfIdeal/Comap.lean and HopfIdeal/Quotient/Basic.lean.
